entities.name: Query ACCase beta
observations: 508 aa; approximately 57.5 kDa; predicted acidic protein with pI 4.83 and charge about -25.5 at pH 7.
Exact full-length sequence match to reviewed Lactuca sativa Q332W9, annotated as acetyl-CoA carboxylase carboxyl transferase subunit beta, chloroplastic.
Contains Pfam Carboxyl_trans domain PF01039 at residues 300-466.
Reference annotations identify a C4-type zinc finger region around residues 248-270 and one bound Zn2+ per subunit.

entities.name: Q332W9
observations: Reviewed Lactuca sativa chloroplastic acetyl-CoA carboxylase carboxyl transferase subunit beta; exact sequence match to the query.
Part of heterohexameric plastid ACCase with biotin carboxylase, biotin carboxyl carrier protein, and alpha/beta carboxyl-transferase subunits.
Catalyzes transfer of carboxyl from carboxybiotinylated carrier protein to acetyl-CoA, producing malonyl-CoA; EC 2.1.3.15.
Annotated to chloroplast stroma, acetyl-CoA carboxylase complex, fatty-acid biosynthesis, and malonyl-CoA biosynthesis.

entities.name: Malonyl-CoA biosynthesis
observations: Plastid acetyl-CoA carboxylase converts acetyl-CoA to malonyl-CoA through a biotin-dependent two-part reaction; the beta carboxyl-transferase subunit performs the transcarboxylation step.

entities.name: Chloroplast stroma
observations: Q332W9 and close reviewed plant homologs are annotated to the chloroplast stroma.
